description: An issue has been identified with the Logi application, as noted in the work logs. The incident was initially logged with a generic short description (matching its sys_id) and an empty description field. Further investigation is required to pinpoint the exact nature of the problem and its impact on users, as the incident is currently in a 'New' state.
steps_to_resolve: Verify incident details and confirm affected services.
Attempt to reproduce in test environment.
Update stakeholders and plan next steps.
Perform root cause analysis and prevention plan.
